antennal olfactory receptor neuron of grooved sensillum of sacculus

best_match.fbbt_definition: Bilateral olfactory receptor neuron that expresses the ionotropic glutamate receptor (Ir) 64a and the co-receptor Ir8a (Benton et al., 2025). There are two subtypes, one that innervates the DC4 glomerulus and one that innervates DP1m (Ai et al., 2010). Its dendrite transduces signals from a grooved sensillum of chamber III of the sacculus (Shanbhag et al., 1995).

justification: A single named receptor type (Ir64a, acid-sensing), matching the FBbt Ir64a ORN term, which covers both DC4 and DP1m subtypes. The authors do not resolve the subtypes.
